purpose: Provide a bounded, answer-free research method and data contract for one resume-ready DELL AI-infrastructure vertical.

case_identity.top_level_question_zh: 公开来源能否证明 Dell AI 基础设施需求的质量、架构与供应兑现、价格数量组合传导、财务兑现和主要反证；不能证明的部分能否被准确记录为有类型、有路径收据的边界？

scope_ceiling.context_entity_rule: A context entity may support demand, supply, architecture, competition or counterevidence; it does not become a second research case.
scope_ceiling.company_financial_window: three fiscal years and at least eight quarters when public
scope_ceiling.industry_and_model_window: rolling twenty-four months plus one landmark baseline when needed
scope_ceiling.regulatory_window: 2022 controls through the exact research cut-off

source_classes.A: free stable API data normalized into SQL with raw-response lineage
source_classes.B: versioned local document or knowledge-base object with content hash and locator
source_classes.C: time-sensitive external page or result that remains a candidate until captured and reviewed
source_classes.D: commercial, private or genuinely undisclosed boundary that is recorded but not fabricated

source_families.purpose: DELL and selected public comparator filings, filing identity and standardized numeric facts
source_families.boundary: CompanyFacts covers standardized entity-wide facts; issuer-specific AI orders, backlog and product metrics require filing or IR document evidence.

source_families.purpose: earnings releases, financial tables, prepared remarks, performance reviews, transcripts and guidance definitions
source_families.boundary: Prepared remarks, Q&A, reported values and forward guidance remain separately typed.

source_families.purpose: Dell SKU, manual, firmware, architecture, cooling, networking and availability state
source_families.boundary: Announcement, support documentation or firmware readiness does not prove shipment, customer deployment or revenue recognition.

source_families.purpose: hyperscaler and named-customer capex, capacity, deployment and customer-side relationship evidence
source_families.boundary: Generic cloud capex is industry context only unless a primary source explicitly names Dell or a Dell SKU.

source_families.purpose: observable public awards, configurations, quantities and bounded price proxies
source_families.boundary: An award, bundle quote or a few projects cannot be extrapolated into Dell company units, ASP, shipment or recognized revenue.

source_families.purpose: GPU and CPU architecture, production, shipment, OEM compatibility and supply context
source_families.boundary: Supplier-wide production, purchase commitments or OEM listings do not prove Dell-specific allocation or revenue.

source_families.purpose: HBM, server DRAM, NAND/eSSD, packaging, networking and storage supply and price direction
source_families.boundary: Directional price commentary is not an exact Dell contract price, BOM or gross-margin contribution.

source_families.purpose: HPE, Supermicro and Lenovo demand definitions, architecture timing, margins and working-capital counterevidence
source_families.boundary: Peer order, backlog and AI revenue labels require definition reconciliation before comparison.

source_families.purpose: model cards, technical reports and MLCommons results that distinguish training, inference and test-time compute
source_families.boundary: A benchmark is not customer demand, installed capacity, provider usage or Dell revenue.

source_families.purpose: Federal Register, eCFR, BIS guidance and restricted-party state
source_families.boundary: A press release or search snippet alone cannot carry the legal conclusion; effective dates, supersession and exact rule text are required.

source_families.purpose: attributed independent reporting for event discovery, contradiction and corroboration
source_families.boundary: Search results, snippets, RSS and aggregators are locators only; material claims require the underlying captured source.

question_branches.objective: Reconcile fiscal identity, metric definitions, orders, revenue, backlog, guidance, profit, working capital and cash.
counter_questions: Did working capital or cash move against the revenue narrative?

question_branches.objective: Separate named deployments, customer cohorts and durable demand from generic capex, pre-buy, double-order and backlog timing.
counter_questions: Is the capacity actual, financed, guided or merely announced?

question_branches.objective: Determine whether units, price and mix can be supported as reported values, bounded observations, scenarios or null gaps.
counter_questions: Does the price include GPU, network, storage, services or financing?
Does the sample cover enough of Dell company activity?

question_branches.objective: Track each platform through announcement, qualification, firmware readiness, production, shipment, deployment and revenue recognition.
counter_questions: Is this a readiness claim or an actual shipment/deployment?
Could an architecture transition delay revenue?

question_branches.objective: Separate HBM, server DRAM, NAND/eSSD, packaging, GPU, networking, liquid cooling and power constraints and their direction of transmission.
counter_questions: Is the evidence Dell-specific or supplier-wide?
Could easing supply raise units while still pressuring OEM margin?

question_branches.objective: Distinguish training, batch inference, low-latency inference and agentic test-time compute and connect only observable demand bridges to systems.
counter_questions: Is this benchmark performance or actual usage?
Could efficiency lower unit demand or increase usage through lower cost?

question_branches.objective: Bind the current rule version, effective date, controlled performance, destination and end-user conditions while separating revenue, supply-chain and customer exposure.
counter_questions: Is the rule current and effective at the research cut-off?
Is Greater China revenue actually disclosed rather than inferred from foreign revenue?

question_branches.objective: Compare only reconciled peer definitions and locate publicly observable value capture across OEM, compute, memory, network and storage layers.
counter_questions: Does faster architecture readiness or better working capital contradict Dell execution?

question_branches.objective: Test every material thesis against a source-bound counterclaim and a monitorable what-would-change condition.
counter_questions: What direct evidence would reverse or narrow the claim?
Is the apparent gap actually an unexecuted or failed retrieval route?

formulas.stop_if: period, unit or metric definition is not comparable
issuer definition uses a different reconciliation without explicit mapping
opening balance, flow denominator or period alignment is unavailable
current revenue cannot be attributed to the opening backlog cohort
cash PP&E, finance leases and total capex are mixed
two or more core inputs are missing or bundle scope is not comparable
ranges rely on a few procurement records extrapolated to the company
scenario assumptions are not separately labeled
benchmark throughput is silently substituted for effective customer utilization

context_delivery.selection_rule: The runtime loads the case summary and authority boundaries once, then calls typed tools for only the active question branch. It never binds the entire corpus or all source families into every model prompt.
context_delivery.model_context_compaction_rule: Keep claim, source identity, bounded excerpt, locator, time, authority state and unresolved counterevidence; omit duplicate raw text and transport internals.

poll_order: Dell IR home and quarterly results
subsequent 10-Q and complete XBRL accession package
freshness_hold_conditions: 8-K attachments present but IR index stale
a current-quarter structured calculation is requested before the 10-Q or another issuer structured table is available
fiscal period or unit not reconciled
call occurred but transcript is not available

acceptance_and_stop.supported_target: At least one direct authoritative source plus one independent cross-entity, customer, supplier or regulatory corroborator when material and publicly available.
acceptance_and_stop.tolerance_policy: The demo may retain disclosed uncertainty, bounded gaps and a small number of non-material misses. It must not hide material contradictions or turn a failed tool route into a public-information gap.
must_have: latest required earnings event refreshed or freshness_hold shown
source, fiscal, publication and effective time identities aligned
material positive claims paired with counterevidence or what-would-change
citations resolve to captured or stable authoritative sources
tool latency, token usage, model calls and failure states visible
stop_and_leave_null: paid or private data is required
company units or ASP can only be extrapolated from bundle prices or a few projects
Greater China revenue can only be inferred from foreign revenue or manufacturing locations
Dell share can only be inferred from generic cloud capex
revenue can only be inferred from a benchmark, announcement or firmware availability
period, unit or definition cannot be disambiguated
a source or parser route failed and has not yet been diagnosed
